name: Planet Finance borrow discount treats freshly borrowed principal as accrued interest
summary: PlanetDiscountDelegate.changeUserBorrowDiscount treats all growth of a borrower's balance since its last snapshot as interest and forgives a discount share of it, while GToken.borrowFresh raises principal without refreshing that snapshot. Holding a discount tier, the attacker alternated borrow() with the public updateUserDiscount(), cutting its recorded debt.

campaign.selection: transactions emitting BorrowDiscountAccrued (topic0 0xac6fac3e) from PlanetDiscount 0x9de8ca4129d5dd4f540e64c25ac61e55ea429589 with a nonzero discount (third data word), other than the anchor and the two listed txs; scanned to block 127465171

notes: The discount contract emitted no nonzero BorrowDiscountAccrued between its last upgrade and the anchor; afterwards the attacker repeated it twice and 111 borrower addresses (bots) farmed it across ten markets, still running at the end of the scan.

Loss is the debt forgiven: the summed discount of every campaign event, in each market's underlying, priced with DefiLlama per 500k-block bucket. For the anchor it equals the gUSDT market's net USDT outflow; bots realise it over several transactions, so per-transaction transfers do not show it.
